license_required.quote: Each person who is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy and whose principal place of business is in this State, whether as a principal or employee of a firm, shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice certified public accountancy.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Delaware State Board of Accountancy.

name.quote: "Board" means the Delaware State Board of Accountancy.

type.quote: The Board of Accountancy shall have the authority to: Formulate rules and regulations, with appropriate notice to those affected.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Division" means the State of Delaware Division of Professional Regulation.

degree_required.value: 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree
degree_required.quote: The applicant has completed at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university acceptable to the Board, the total educational program to include an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by Board rule to be appropriate

accrediting_body.value: accredited college or university acceptable to the Board
accrediting_body.quote: conferred by an accredited college or university acceptable to the Board

required.quote: The applicant has had 1 year of experience.

duration.quote: The applicant has had 1 year of experience.

kind.value: supervised accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting services
kind.quote: This experience shall include providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills all of which was supervised by a United States certified public accountant

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and/or such successor examinations as may be required to qualify for a permit to practice

exams.name: AICPA Code of Ethics examination
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the AICPA self-study course and examination in professional ethics

interval_years.quote: Permits to practice shall be initially issued, and renewed, for periods of not more than 2 years but in any event shall expire on June 30 of the odd-numbered year following issuance or renewal.

required.quote: An applicant for renewal of a permit under this section shall show that the applicant has completed no less than 80 hours of continuing professional education as determined by Board rule during the 2-year renewal period that has elapsed since the last biennial renewal date.

hours_per_period.quote: no less than 80 hours of continuing professional education as determined by Board rule during the 2-year renewal period

period_years.quote: during the 2-year renewal period that has elapsed since the last biennial renewal date

available.quote: Reciprocal permits to practice shall be issued to applicants who have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit to practice in a substantially equivalent state or who individually are determined to be substantially equivalent.

requirements.value: Applicants must have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit in a substantially equivalent state, or be individually determined to be substantially equivalent. Alternatively, applicants not qualifying under substantial equivalency must show 4 years of experience after passing the examination within the 10 years preceding application, and if the certificate was issued more than 4 years prior, must have fulfilled continuing professional education requirements.
requirements.quote: Reciprocal permits to practice shall be issued to applicants who have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit to practice in a substantially equivalent state or who individually are determined to be substantially equivalent... With regard to applicants that do not qualify for reciprocity under the substantial equivalency standard set out in § 109 of this title, the Board shall issue a permit to practice to a holder of a certificate, license or permit issued by another state upon a showing that: a. The applicant passed the Uniform CPA Examination; b. The applicant had 4 years of experience of the type described in § 107(f) of this title or meets comparable requirements prescribed by the Board by rule, after passing the examination upon which the applicant's certificate was based and within the 10 years immediately preceding the application; and c. If the applicant's certificate, license or permit was issued more than 4 years prior to the application for issuance of an initial certificate under this section, that the applicant has fulfilled the requirements of continuing professional education that would have been applicable under subsection (d) of this section.

exists.quote: The Board of Accountancy shall have the authority to: Formulate rules and regulations, with appropriate notice to those affected.

national_certification.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_certification.quote: The Board shall adopt the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination as the national examination to be taken by all applicants for licensure as certified public accountants and use the advisory grading service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), or its successor organization.

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: use the advisory grading service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), or its successor organization

regulatory_model.quote: Each person who is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy and whose principal place of business is in this State, whether as a principal or employee of a firm, shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice certified public accountancy.

credential_type.quote: "Permit" or "permit to practice" means a permit issued by the Board to practice either public accountancy or certified public accountancy.

is_mandatory.quote: Each person who is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy and whose principal place of business is in this State, whether as a principal or employee of a firm, shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice certified public accountancy.

title_protection.quote: The use of the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that a person is a certified public accountant shall be limited to a person who holds an active permit to practice issued by the Board pursuant to this chapter or issued under the laws of another jurisdiction.

scope_protection.quote: No person or firm shall perform compilation, review or audit services, as defined by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), except holders of a valid permit to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire or renew a certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire or renew a certificate or permit to practice or be otherwise authorized to practice accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonated another person holding a certificate or permit, or allowed another to use the individual's certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: impersonated another person holding a certificate or permit to practice; or allowed another person to use the individual's certificate or permit to practice; or aided or abetted a person not holding a certificate or permit to practice to represent himself or herself as holding a certificate or permit to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud or gross negligence in the practice of accounting or engaged in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in an act of fraud or gross negligence in the practice of accounting or engaged in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct intended to or likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a crime substantially related to the practice of accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty of or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a crime that is substantially related to the practice of accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary sanction, censure, or revocation/suspension of certificate or permit in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been subject to disciplinary sanction or censured or has had the individual's certificate or permit to practice revoked or suspended in any other state for any cause other than failure to pay an annual registration fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary sanction, censure, or revocation of right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been subject to disciplinary sanction or censured or has had the individual's right to practice revoked before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a lawful provision of the chapter or any lawful regulation or rule of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a lawful provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation or rule of professional conduct established thereunder

definition_quote.value: the performance, or offer to perform, for a client or a potential client, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a CPA permit holder, of 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports or financial statements, or of 1 or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters
definition_quote.quote: "Certified public accounting" or "the practice of certified public accountancy" means the performance, or offer to perform, for a client or a potential client, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a CPA permit holder, of 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports or financial statements, or of 1 or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: a. Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); b. Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); c. Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); d. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB; and e. Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with, and as defined by, Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS).

education_semester_hours_required.quote: The applicant has completed at least 150 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university acceptable to the Board

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: the applicant may not sit for said exams until that applicant has successfully completed at least 120 semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university acceptable to the Board

ethics_exam_required.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the AICPA self-study course and examination in professional ethics

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an individual who offers or renders professional services, whether in person, by mail, telephone or electronic means, under this section shall be granted practice privileges in this State and no notice or other submission shall be provided by any such individual.

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board
compliance with the chapter and the Board's rules
cessation of practice if license from home state is no longer valid
appointment of home state Board as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the firm which employs that licensee hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: a. To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board; b. To comply with this chapter and the Board's rules; c. That in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in this State individually and on behalf of a firm; and d. To the appointment of the State Board which issued their license as their agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by this Board against the licensee.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a permit to practice under this section shall be required to register each office of the firm within this State with the Board and to affirm that all attest and compilation services rendered in this State are under the charge of a person holding an active permit to practice issued under this chapter or qualifies for the practice privilege under § 109 of this title.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to holders of a CPA certificate, CPA permit, or CPA license who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although firms may include nonlicensee owners, the firm and its ownership must comply with applicable rules promulgated by the Board... Any certified public accounting firm as defined in this title may include nonlicensee owners provided that: a. The firm designated a permit holder of this State who is responsible for the proper registration of the firm and identifies that individual to the Board. b. All nonlicensee owners are active individual participants in the certified public accounting firm or affiliated entities. c. The firm complies with such other requirements as the Board may impose by rule.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: the Board shall by rule require as a condition to renewal of permits under this section, that firms that provide attest and/or compilation services be enrolled in a board-approved peer review program and comply with the applicable standards and guidance of that program

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Shall include reasonable provision for compliance by a firm showing that it has, within the preceding 3 years, undergone a peer review.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board may by rule create an exception to this requirement for permit holders who do not perform or offer to perform 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including issuance of reports on financial statements or of 1 or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters, and who make application for inactive status to the Board.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may engage in the practice of certified public accountancy in this State through an individual practicing pursuant to the practice privilege afforded by § 109 of this title without obtaining a permit under this section or otherwise notifying the Board.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a permit to practice under this section shall be required to register each office of the firm within this State with the Board and to affirm that all attest and compilation services rendered in this State are under the charge of a person holding an active permit to practice issued under this chapter or qualifies for the practice privilege under § 109 of this title.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a permit holder or a partner, shareholder, officer, director or employee of a permit holder, incident to or in the course of rendering services to a client, except the reports submitted by the permit holder to the client, and except for records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the permit holder in the absence of an express agreement between the permit holder and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary contained herein, an individual who is not a licensee of the Board shall not be prohibited the use of the following language in connection with financial statements: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing in the form of financial statements information that is the representation of management (owners). I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance within 60 days.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Each firm with an office in this State and which intends to be or is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy or the practice of public accountancy in this State shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice.

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: Each person who intends to be or is engaged in the practice of public accountancy in this State, whether as a principal of a firm or an employee of a firm, shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice public accountancy.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A permit holder shall furnish to permit holder's client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: A copy of the permit holder's working papers, to the extent that such working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; or Any accounting or other records belonging to or obtained from or on behalf of the client that the permit holder removed from the client's premises or received for the client's account
